values.config_text:
hostname LAB-R1
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip address 10.72.0.1 255.255.255.252
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf 20 area 0
router ospf 20
 router-id 198.19.71.1

set system host-name LAB-R2
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.72.0.2/30
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/0.0 interface-type p2p
set routing-options autonomous-system 65020
set protocols bgp group CEDAR type external
set protocols bgp group CEDAR peer-as 65030
set protocols bgp group CEDAR neighbor 10.72.0.6

sysname LAB-R3
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.72.0.6 255.255.255.252
quit
bgp 65030
 peer 10.72.0.5 as-number 65020
